explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is a technical step inside the library's Langlands–Tunnell / Rankin–Selberg development. Its statement uses only the library's own definitions: CubicInductionForm, whittakerLoc, finiteAdelicGL2Subgroup, RSCarrier.finFactor, localAt, globalPoints, transposeInvN, longWeyl3, iotaGL, embS and others. It bundles five properties of the auxiliary functions Wfd and R. These are measurability, a unit-modulus phase under the unipotent subgroup, measurability of R, invariance of the norm of R, and an isolation identity. Mathlib has no adelic GL2/GL3 Whittaker functions and none of these constructions. The proof just combines library lemmas (measurable_Wfd, measurable_R, norm_R_unipotent_mul, exists_phase_Wfd, isolation_identity, ext_of_glArch_localAt). It calls no single Mathlib declaration that carries the mathematical content, so I did not search Mathlib further.
